items.desc: Indulge in the exclusive Set Menu experience at Bright Courtyard Club — where luxury Chinese dining meets exceptional value in the heart of London. Carefully curated by expert chefs, the Bright Courtyard Set Menu is designed to take you on a journey through some of the restaurant’s most celebrated Cantonese and Shanghainese flavours. Perfect for sharing, every course is thoughtfully prepared using premium ingredients, elegant presentation, and authentic cooking techniques that bring together tradition and modern fine dining. Choose one set meal for two (dine-in only, no takeout):   · Set Meal A (Soup + Scallop + Peking Duck + Angus Beef + King Prawns + Vegetables + Rice)   · Set Meal B – Vegetarian (Buddha's Delight + Vegetarian Peking Duck + Pumpkin Fried Rice + more)   · Peking Duck Served in Two Ways (Classic whole duck feast) Whether you’re discovering Bright Courtyard for the first time or returning for another unforgettable meal, the Set Menu is the perfect way to experience a selection of the restaurant’s finest dishes all in one sitting. ✨ Elegant atmosphere 📍 Located in Baker Street, London 🍽️ Perfect for groups, celebrations & luxury dining lovers Reserve your table now and experience one of London’s most refined Chinese set menu experiences. #london #londonhotspots #chinesefood #foodlondon #londonfoodguide
